title: Irshad Ahmad v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.; Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Petition disposed; recovery withdrawn; fresh order after hearing.
headnote: Writ against a final assessment order dated 12 August 2021, passed under the Electricity Act, 2003 in a theft case, was disposed of after the Electricity Department stated that recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after hearing, following the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Irshad Ahmad filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and two others, challenging the Electricity Department's final assessment order dated 12 August 2021. That order was passed under the Electricity Act, 2003 in a case of alleged theft of electricity. When the petition was taken up, counsel for the Electricity Department told the Court that the recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after the petitioner was heard.

holding_units.topic: Fresh order after withdrawal of theft-assessment recovery
holding_units.holding: On the Electricity Department's statement that recovery under the final assessment order dated 12 August 2021 had been withdrawn, the writ was disposed of with liberty to pass a fresh order after hearing the petitioner and after following the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: No Supply Code clause number is stated. The order also refers to the Electricity Act, 2003 without a section number.

principle_tags.application: The Division Bench did not construe any Supply Code clause or Electricity Act section. It disposed of the writ on the Department's statement that recovery under the 12 August 2021 theft assessment had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would follow the procedure prescribed by the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 after hearing.

not_decided.point: Whether the assessment dated 12 August 2021 for alleged theft of electricity was lawful on merits
not_decided.note: Recovery was withdrawn by the Department. A fresh order after hearing, under the Supply Code procedure, was left to be passed.
